_comment: Nano Banana (Gemini image) prompts for the split-test-v1 champion LP. Generate one set PER CLIENT, save under sites/{slug}/public/images/lp/, then wire the four URLs into the manifest entry (heroImageUrl, featureImageUrl, supportImageUrl, closingImageUrl). Use model 'pro' for quality. These prompts are tuned for water-damage restoration — adjust nouns for the client's niche/service (e.g. fire, mold, HVAC, plumbing).

images.prompt: Photorealistic low-angle photograph taken near water-surface level inside a flooded home kitchen, an adult man standing in dark burgundy-red rubber rain boots and dark denim jeans, seen from the knees down, positioned slightly right of center, several inches of clean clear standing water covering the tile floor with strong mirror-like reflections filling the entire foreground, clean white kitchen cabinets and a front-load washing machine in the background, balanced natural daylight, atmospheric and dramatic but clearly visible, no debris, no trash, no garbage, just clean floodwater, tidy home, shallow depth of field, emotional water-damage emergency scene, no text, no logos, professional real estate photography. NOTE: keep the subject slightly right of center and low in the frame so the centered headline overlays open water; works at any crop.

Photorealistic white cargo work van parked on a wet residential street in front of a brick house, rear doors open revealing organized restoration equipment, hoses, and water extraction machinery with warm interior lighting, overcast day, professional commercial photography, no visible brand logos, no text.

Photorealistic orange air mover blower fan and dehumidifier drying a wet hardwood floor in a residential living room after water damage, professional restoration equipment running, realistic lighting, no people, no text, commercial photography style.

Photorealistic bright restored modern living room with large windows, clean refinished hardwood floors, fresh walls, natural daylight, warm and inviting, fully repaired after restoration, no people, no text, real estate interior photography.

fire-damage-restoration.heroImageUrl: Photorealistic interior of a home with fire and smoke damage, charred wall and soot staining, dramatic moody lighting, water from firefighting on the floor, emergency scene, no people, no text, cinematic professional photography.
fire-damage-restoration.closingImageUrl: Photorealistic fully restored bright living room after fire damage repair, fresh paint, new flooring, natural daylight, warm and inviting, no people, no text, real estate photography.
